**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — §7.3/7.4 (p0078–p0079)

- **What exists:** An express warranty that the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation, plus media, no-malicious-code and Y2K warranties. Remedies are correction, then replacement, then termination with refund of prepaid fees — adequate under the playbook.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** The Warranty Period is only sixty (60) days from the Effective Date and expires "in no event later than December 31, 1999." Acceptance Testing under §3.1 itself runs through December 31, 1999, so the warranty would lapse at or before acceptance — materially short of the 90-day software fallback.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** 12 months measured from acceptance under §3.1, calendar cut-off deleted; plus a professional-and-workmanlike warranty with re-performance/refund for Commerce One's installation, implementation and other professional services (currently absent). Comment offers 90 days from acceptance as the fallback.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the disclaimer text at p0084 appears truncated in this copy but on its face disclaims only implied warranties and does not swallow the express warranties.
